incident-bot: ALERT fired: streaming.response.chunk_delay.p99 > 3s over last 5m — service: streaming-proxy — sev=P1 :rotating_light:
ops-alarms: paging sam (oncall) :bell:
sam (oncall): seeing the page, looking now. can someone grab customer impact?
priya (eng-sre): I’ve pulled p95/p99 from graphite — p95 ~ 800ms, p99 ~ 3.4s for /v1/generate/stream routes in us-east-1. Errors are low but tail latency up.
morgan (eng-runtime): adding logs from runtime — noticing many LONG_WRITE entries from chunk-aggregator to downstream socket. sample:
```
2026-03-15T14:02:12Z LONG_WRITE id=abc123 conn=10.5.2.8:52344 bytes=4096 duration_ms=1800
2026-03-15T14:02:13Z LONG_WRITE id=def456 conn=10.5.2.9:52345 bytes=1024 duration_ms=2100
```
sam (oncall): ok looks like backpressure at proxy->client. is this client slow consumers or proxy buffering?
alex (eng-platform): deployed a proxy tweak 30m ago that increased upstream buffer to 64kb (was 8kb) to reduce small packet overhead. rolling that back now.
devex-bot: deploy started: proxy-config rollback (deploy-789) by alex — ETA 45s
priya (eng-sre): quick mitigation suggestions: 1) roll back proxy buffer change (alex) 2) reduce chunk flush interval (runtime) 3) enable short-term rate limit for noisy clients 4) restart chunk-aggregator on two busiest hosts
nina (support): got inbound from two customers reporting stalled responses in integrations. affected customers: internal-corp, partner-analytics. notifying them status page now.
sam (oncall): priya and morgan please coordinate. I’ll update status and own comms. priya, can you scope whether this is client backpressure vs proxy stall?
priya (eng-sre): starting tcpdump on one conn now to see zero-window or stalled ACKs.
morgan (eng-runtime): decreasing flush interval in runtime config from 200ms -> 50ms on canary set to force smaller chunks. patch applied to canary nodes. command:
```bash
curl -XPOST http://runtime-canary/api/admin/config -d '{"stream.flush_ms":50}'
```
sam (oncall): devex-bot — status page update draft?
devex-bot: Draft posted: "Investigating — some customers may see delayed streaming responses. Engineers are investigating. No data loss reported." (will publish on confirm)
alex (eng-platform): rollback complete. proxy buffer back to 8kb on all frontends. logs show fewer LONG_WRITE entries but still some high tail.
priya (eng-sre): tcpdump shows lots of ACKs, not zero-window. clients responding but receiving bursts slowly. suggests proxy was batching too much or TCP cwnd issues downstream. also seeing increased write syscall EAGAIN on aggregators.
morgan (eng-runtime): restarted chunk-aggregator on host aggr-11 and aggr-12. saw immediate improvement on those hosts p99 -> 700ms. rolling restarts to remaining aggrs but staggering.
sam (oncall): good. enable temporary rate-limit for top 0.5% noisy API keys to protect global SLOs? we should rate-limit at the proxy edge.
alex (eng-platform): applied token-based soft-limit for top 0.5% clients: 25% reduced concurrency, 429 on burst. watch metrics.
priya (eng-sre): keep an eye on downstream queuing — adding extra monitoring for write syscall latency and chunk queue depth.
nina (support): customers notified: internal-corp acknowledged, partner-analytics asking for workaround; recommending non-streaming fallback (polling) for now.
morgan (eng-runtime): also found a regression in our chunk coalescer that attempts to merge small writes into bigger writes when socket writable. reverting that commit on canary. commit id: 9f3a2b.
sam (oncall): devex-bot publish status update to users: "Mitigation in progress — we've rolled back a proxy config change and are restarting services. Some customers may still experience delays; recommended workaround: disable streaming or increase client read buffer."
